findings.summary: Stale docstring: CompositeOwnerSource still says 'Production runs the dd owner and the line owner together … a decision note can name a dd development or a parked line', contradicting the R3/S11 deletion its own module header states. No behavioral surface — no dd owner source or OWNER_KIND_DD exists anywhere in src/ — but the prose misleads a future reader of the deleted second delivery path.

dispatched_by is normalized with strip() at both the parse layer (goal_line.declared_actions) and the gateway lock (ControlPlaneGateway.admit), so a whitespace-padded payload value reaches record.json trimmed rather than byte-verbatim. The M2 invariant is unaffected (equality is checked strip-side on both ends, and empty-after-strip fails closed at two locks), but '逐字透传' holds exactly only for already-trimmed line ids, which is the only form the line-identity check admits.
